q: The Lempel-Ziv compression algorithm achieves near-optimal compression for stationary ergodic sources. The LZ77 algorithm parses the string into phrases, each defined as the longest match in the preceding text. The compression ratio satisfies:
opts: Converges to H̄ (the entropy rate) almost surely for ergodic sources as n → ∞
Equals H̄ only for i.i.d. sources
exp: Ziv-Lempel theorem: for any ergodic stationary source, the LZ compression ratio (bits per symbol output by LZ77/78) converges a.s. to the entropy rate H̄. This makes LZ-based algorithms universally asymptotically optimal—no prior knowledge of the source is needed.
